payload.taskDescription: Pin tesseract.js 7.0.0, tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, and @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0. Add scripts/copy-ocr-assets.mjs to copy worker.min.js, tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js, tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm, and 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz into public/ocr, and wire postinstall, predev, and prebuild so the assets always exist. Create ocrAssets.ts to build same-origin URLs from import.meta.env.BASE_URL and configure workerPath, corePath, and langPath. Create ocrWorker.ts and useOcr.ts with one job at a time, 60-second timeout, cancel, terminate, and cleanup. Add OCR text, confidence, engineVersion, and updatedAt to the card model and mappers. Add scripts/check-ocr-assets.mjs and a test that fails if the four built assets are missing or the OCR module uses an external origin. Do not add UI.
